subject.title: Bound batch file read with size cap in config-set-input

question: Should `openclaw config set --batch-file` adopt a fixed 8 MiB maximum input size, knowingly rejecting previously accepted larger local batch files?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but the selected cap creates a compatibility-visible CLI input contract and the submitted evidence does not show why 8 MiB is the approved threshold for configuration batches.

options.title: Approve a fixed 8 MiB cap
options.body: Keep the one-size safety bound, add focused boundary coverage and real CLI proof, and retain no new configuration surface.

options.title: Choose a different contract
options.body: Specify a different fixed limit or an alternate supported batch-input design before this PR is revised.

recommendation.title: Approve a fixed 8 MiB cap
recommendation.body: Keep the one-size safety bound, add focused boundary coverage and real CLI proof, and retain no new configuration surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the directly relevant merged bounded-read precedent and can provide the implementation context, although final product direction should be confirmed by a repository owner.
